headline: Take-Two Interactive Generates $2.36 Billion in Single-Day Sales of GTA VI
summary: Take-Two Interactive sold 24.58 million copies of Grand Theft Auto VI in a single day, generating an estimated $2.36 billion in initial revenue.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a global video game publisher whose major releases represent some of the highest-grossing entertainment software products globally.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: Grand Theft Auto VI achieved $2.36 billion in sales on its launch day.
